evals.prompt: Convert this iPhone .qta spatial audio recording into a normal m4a I can share.
evals.expected_output: Probe with afinfo and ffprobe. Stream-copy Track 0 (stereo AAC) with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c:a copy to a .m4a next to the source. Keep the source and verify the output with afinfo.
assertions: Triggers audio-convert
Probes with both afinfo and ffprobe first
Uses a stream copy (-map 0:a:0 -c:a copy) for the stereo AAC track
Keeps the source file and verifies the output with afinfo

evals.prompt: Extract the 4-channel APAC ambisonic track from recording.qta as a 24-bit WAV for Reaper.
evals.expected_output: Probe first. Decode Track 1 with afconvert --read-track 1 -f WAVE -d LEI24, because ffmpeg cannot decode APAC. Verify with afinfo and tell the user that the WAV holds ACN/SN3D ambisonics without a channel-layout tag.
assertions: Uses afconvert --read-track 1 -f WAVE -d LEI24 instead of ffmpeg for APAC
Tells the user that the WAV has no channel-layout tag and that the channels are ACN/SN3D ambisonics
Verifies the output codec, channel count, and duration with afinfo

evals.prompt: Pull the audio track out of demo.mov as an MP3.
evals.expected_output: Probe demo.mov with afinfo and ffprobe. Re-encode the audio stream with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 next to the source, and verify with afinfo.
assertions: Triggers audio-convert for audio extraction from video
Selects the audio stream explicitly with -map 0:a:0
Re-encodes to MP3 and verifies the output with afinfo

evals.prompt: Make a stereo version of the ambisonic track in my iPhone spatial recording.
evals.expected_output: Probe first. Use Track 0, the stereo AAC downmix that the recording already contains, with an ffmpeg stream copy. Do not attempt an afconvert downmix of the APAC track or a -c 2 channel drop.
assertions: Triggers audio-convert
Uses Track 0 as the stereo version
Does not downmix the APAC track with afconvert
Verifies the output with afinfo

evals.prompt: Re-encode talk.m4a from ALAC to 256k AAC .m4a without overwriting the original.
evals.expected_output: Probe talk.m4a first. Choose a distinct output path such as talk-256k.m4a because the extension matches the source, re-encode with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c:a aac -b:a 256k, keep talk.m4a intact, and verify the new file's codec, bitrate, and duration with afinfo.
assertions: Triggers audio-convert
Uses a distinct output path to avoid colliding with talk.m4a
Re-encodes to AAC instead of stream-copying
Keeps the source file intact and verifies the new file with afinfo

evals.prompt: Transcribe this interview.m4a into a text transcript with speaker labels.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger audio-convert. Route the request to a speech-to-text or transcription workflow.
assertions: Does not trigger audio-convert for transcription
Runs no ffmpeg or afconvert conversion unless the transcription tool needs a different format

evals.prompt: Trim the silence from this podcast episode and normalize the loudness to -16 LUFS.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger audio-convert. Audio editing and mastering are outside this skill's scope.
assertions: Does not trigger audio-convert for audio editing or mastering

evals.prompt: Re-encode this 4K ProRes video to 1080p H.264 MP4.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger audio-convert. Video transcoding is outside this skill's scope.
assertions: Does not trigger audio-convert for video transcoding
